reason: We just dragged 950 members and a worn-out volunteer team through a migration off E-Golf4U; I'm not putting them through another one within a year for a product whose first pilot club isn't even live yet.
objection: Nothing here says it links to the NGF handicap system or handles our SEPA direct debit for contributions, and with two founders and zero live clubs I'd be betting the club's core admin on a startup that might not be around in three years.
would_change_my_mind: A comparable 18-hole club running it live for a full season with a working NGF/handicap link and direct debit, and a contract that lets us exit after the pilot with our data exported at no cost.
